summary: Yiren Digital filed a 6-K attaching a press release updating investors on an investigation involving affiliates of its controlling shareholder that it says relates to activities outside the company. Management reaffirmed operational independence, disclosed a prior credit-loss provision on related-party loan receivables, and reaffirmed a July 2, 2026 board-authorized buyback of up to US$20 million over 12 months, backed by roughly RMB1.7 billion (US$250 million) of cash at June 30, 2026. Watch for governance contagion, further related-party impairments, and actual repurchase execution under the program.
